responsibility: Implements impl specialization support above coherence, including argument translation between specialized and parent impls, construction of specialization graphs for traits, and reporting of overlap conflicts and future-compatibility diagnostics.
same_name_distinction: Among the `traits/*/mod.rs` files, this one is the specialization/coherence boundary for overlapping impls. Its code is concerned with subset checks between impls, translating substitutions across parent and child impls, consulting the specialization graph, and emitting overlap diagnostics, rather than ordinary trait selection, query organization, or general error-reporting support.
